blocks.heading: Entry Rules From Official Sources
rows: UGC NET (assistant professor, JRF)

Paper 1 has 50 questions for 100 marks. Paper 2 (geography) has 100 questions for 200 marks. Qualifying marks are 40 percent (general) and 35 percent (reserved). JRF has an age cap of 30, with relaxations.
A bachelor's alone does not qualify. Plan the master's first.
ugcnet.nta.nic.in. For the December 2026 cycle, Careers360 lists applications from 8 to 28 October 2026 and exams from 14 to 19 December 2026. Confirm on the NTA notice.
UPSC Civil Services
Geography is one of the optional subjects. One aggregator reported about 933 vacancies for the 2026 cycle.
The optional is a choice, not an advantage by itself.
upsc.gov.in for the current notice, age limit and attempts.
Survey of India (surveyor posts)

Published 2013 rules: Surveyor Senior (Group B) asks for a B.Sc with maths, 60 percent (50 percent for SC and ST), direct-recruit age 21 to 28. Surveyor Junior (Group C) asks for Intermediate with maths, 60 percent. Officer Surveyor (Group B, gazetted) is filled 100 percent by promotion.
A BA without maths does not meet these rules.
surveyofindia.gov.in. Rules have been revised since 2013, so read the current advertisement.
NRSC (ISRO)
March 2024 notice for temporary research posts: Project Associate-I asked for an M.Sc in Remote Sensing or GIS with a B.Sc in any subject. No post named geography.
isro.gov.in and nrsc.gov.in recruitment pages. Posts change each notice.
IIRS free online courses
A certificate needs 70 percent attendance, and students must also pass an online exam.
A free, credible way to test whether you like spatial work before paying for a course.
iirs.gov.in. The article does not give a batch year or seat count.
M.Plan at CEPT (urban planning)

2026-27 admissions: a four-year bachelor's including Geography among listed fields, at least 50 percent (45 percent reserved). A CEPT PG Test, GATE or UGC NET score is mandatory. 132 seats. The detailed list of eligible degrees names M.A. or M.Sc. Geography.
Geography is plausible, but confirm in writing whether a bachelor's in geography is accepted.
cept.ac.in. The 2026-27 application closed on 12 July 2026.

blocks.heading: Routes That Filter You Twice
rows: Civil services
Prelims, Mains and interview, repeated across attempts, with a low selection rate for every optional.
After selection, a pay scale and cadre. Growth is by seniority and posting, not by anything you can scale yourself.
Teaching and research
A master's with the required marks, then NET or JRF.
A funded PhD seat, then a permanent post. NET qualification does not give either.
Space and remote sensing
The 2024 posts were temporary. A permanent role is a separate selection.
Urban planning
Entry into planning firms and authorities. Ask any course for its last placement list and the roles in it, not an average.

Authorities and planning firms; later private developers and consultants.
Studio work, faculty and alumni, tenders and empanelment lists (check the current rules).

Government or institution. Employer-only.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: Use 10 percent of your family's total education budget as a starting benchmark for college fees. It is a planning rule, not a research fact.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: If the total budget is 10 lakh rupees, the benchmark is about 1 lakh rupees for the degree, and the rest pays for living, tools, internet, courses, projects and later upskilling. Going above roughly 20 percent needs course-specific evidence, such as a licence the route legally needs, lab or field access you cannot get elsewhere, or verified placement outcomes with the median shown.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Payscale (updated February 2026, 25 profiles) puts the early-career average base pay at about 3.9 lakh rupees a year, with the middle of the range running from about 1.9 lakh at the 10th percentile to about 8.3 lakh at the 90th.
